# Bipity Bopity Cakes

> Custom cake and cupcake bakery run by Amanda Costa, serving Lodi, Stockton, Galt, and Lockeford, CA, and surrounding San Joaquin County. Home-based, no public storefront; pickup and delivery arranged per order. No published menu, pricing, or hours yet — contact directly for current details.

- [About](https://www.bipitybopitycakes.com/#about): Background on Amanda and the bakery's style.
- [Gallery](https://www.bipitybopitycakes.com/#gallery): Photos of custom cakes and cupcakes (birthdays, weddings/engagements, gender reveals, novelty themes).
- [FAQ](https://www.bipitybopitycakes.com/#faq): Answers to common questions about service area, delivery, lead times, and dietary options.
- [Contact](https://www.bipitybopitycakes.com/#contact): Phone, email, Instagram, and Facebook.
